Keyboard accessibility
Keyboard-only form · 1. Email · a@example.com · 2. Password · •••••••• · 3. Sign in Tab order
Read the diagram step by step

Tab moves focus in the normal document order. Shift+Tab moves backwards. A visible focus
outline tells users where they are. Native buttons support keyboard activation.
Tab එJකෙන් focus එකෙ ඊළඟ control එකෙට යෙනවා. Shift+Tab එJකෙන් ආපෙසු යෙනවා. Focus outline එකෙ JපෙJනන්න ඕJන්. Native button keyboard එJකෙන් කික්‍රියො කෙරයි.
